prompt: Section 3.1 of SceneAgent. You are the orchestrator. Plan the remaining conversion of a captured scene into a simulation-ready one: choose the stages to run and their order. Use only these stage ids: material_vote, mujoco_load, sam3d, partsam, isaac_inspector, icp, isaac_mesh, mujoco_mesh, cubepart, articulate. Do not repeat a stage. A stage may appear only after the stages it requires: partsam after sam3d; icp after sam3d; isaac_mesh after icp; mujoco_mesh after isaac_mesh; cubepart after partsam; articulate after partsam. For every stage you choose, write a short procedure in markdown: what the stage takes in, what it must produce, and how to tell it worked. Later conversions read those procedures instead of planning again. Answer with steps (your order) and procedures (one entry per chosen stage).
